items.title: I Was Wrong About GTA 6
items.summary: Some months ago, I wrote about how, even prior to its full reveal, we already knew what GTA 6 was going to be . Although not unique to the franchise by any means, GTA games had always followed a very clear formula, rarely upending it in any meaningful way. I strongly suspected that the 13-year wait for GTA 6 would result in a very pretty version of a very familiar game. As release approached, I worried that for all of the praise heaped upon its story and incredible level of detail, all of that was merely a veneer on the same game we've been playing for 25 years. items.summary: Pinball remains such an intoxicating game because it's one where you have to constantly be on your toes. As the tiny metal sphere bats about the place, it's down to you to hit it at just the right time so as to keep racking up points upon points. It's a game of skill as much as it is luck. It is also incredibly silly, which is why I'm so tickled by Appulse, a sci-fi pinball roguelite top-down shooter that launched today wherein your ball is actually the main defence system on your spaceship.
